en.official: Regarding the Ordinance Partially Amending the Kokubunji City Ordinance Concerning Medical Expense Assistance for Children of Compulsory Education Age
en.summary: This ordinance sets out medical expense assistance for children of compulsory education age. With the start of connection to the information-sharing infrastructure, it updates the provisions and wording concerning the assistance.
